_readme: start = output time when the crossfade INTO that slide begins (seconds or 'm:ss.s'). anchor = the transcript line the cut is timed to. chapter = YouTube chapter title (omit on cues that should not start a chapter, e.g. inside a recap montage).

cues.anchor: 00:00.0 hosts open; 00:51.9 'We're pulling from a presentation by ...'
cues.note: Title card until the hosts name the speaker and event
Returning to an earlier slide is fine when the audio comes back to it
Recap montage: only this first cue carries a chapter

cues.anchor: 18:05.2 'What a compelling note to leave on'
